facts.value: Designed as a joint honours degree, the BA in Law and Accounting offers you a full law degree and full accounting degree. Because at this stage, you may not know what career you would like to pursue, the BA Law and Accounting degree allows you to pursue either career, while using skills from both disciplines to enhance your chosen professional career path.
You have an interest in both law and accounting and would like to pursue both subjects at University.
You like reading, and have an analytical mind. You like to solve problems, and are inquisitive.
You are also self-disciplined and motivated.
